summary: Studio onboarding gate (Jan 2026) tested end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest passed in /app/backend/tests/test_studio_onboarding.py — POST /api/auth/admin/register returns profile_complete=false; POST /api/auth/admin/profile with valid bearer saves studio_profile, sets profile_complete=true and updates users.name to studio_name and users.phone to profile phone; blank required field returns 400; missing key returns 422; auth missing returns 401; GET /api/auth/me reflects profile_complete=true after save; superadmin (prabhakar@pkphotography.in / SuperAdmin@3214) login unaffected and /api/superadmin/overview works. Frontend: on 390x844 mobile viewport (a) registering a fresh studio via /admin-login (toggle to register, name+email+password) redirects to /studio-onboarding (studio-onboarding-screen), (b) onb-submit aria-disabled=true until all required fields are valid — clicking it while disabled keeps user on onboarding, (c) after filling onb-contact-name, onb-studio-name, onb-phone, tapping onb-purpose-Weddings, onb-city, onb-country the button becomes enabled and submit navigates to /admin with admin-dashboard-screen rendered, and (d) existing admin admin@lumiere.studio / Admin@12345 is correctly redirected to /studio-onboarding on login (profile_complete=false confirmed via /api/auth/admin/login curl). All documented testIDs found: studio-onboarding-screen, onb-contact-name, onb-studio-name, onb-phone, onb-purpose-Weddings (chip), onb-city, onb-country, onb-submit, admin-login-screen, admin-email-input, admin-password-input, admin-submit-btn, admin-toggle-mode, admin-name-input.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow) and 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing' on admin-login and studio-onboarding screens. Non-blocking. Reference: shared theme (colors/shadows) + KeyboardAwareScrollView animations. Already flagged in iterations 2/3.

action_items: (Optional) When existing studios are seeded/migrated, consider back-filling profile_complete=true for admin@lumiere.studio if it should be treated as already onboarded — currently it's correctly gated because its stored user has no studio_profile. Confirm this matches the product intent (spec says 'Applies to ALL studios with an incomplete profile (existing accounts too)' — matches current behaviour).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/auth/admin/profile: whitespace-only fields are rejected with 400 via `value.strip()` check — good. Consider mirroring the same trim/length validation in Pydantic (constr(min_length=1)) so the error is uniform (400 vs 422). Non-blocking, current UX is fine because the frontend guards with canSubmit.

_public_user returns profile_complete via bool(user.get('profile_complete')) — safe default for legacy users (undefined -> False), which is exactly what powers the gate for the pre-existing admin@lumiere.studio account.
admin/_layout.tsx redirect order (loading -> user -> role -> profile_complete -> children) is correct and prevents races before session hydration.

studio-onboarding.tsx canSubmit uses phone.trim().length >= 6 matching backend requirement; chip selection uses local state so purpose is always a single string that matches backend body.purpose contract.

Google-signed-in studios also flow through the same gate: /auth/session returns a user via _public_user, so profile_complete defaults to False for new Google users → they will hit the onboarding screen too. Verified by contract (not exercised in UI test).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested UI flows (new-studio registration -> onboarding gate -> disabled submit -> filled submit -> /admin dashboard; existing admin login -> onboarding gate)

seed_data_creation: Each pytest run creates a fresh TEST_studio_<uuid>@test.com admin (module scope) and completes its profile. UI test also registered a studio_ui_<ts>@test.com and completed onboarding. These are safe residuals that do not affect existing seeded data (admin@lumiere.studio, prabhakar@pkphotography.in were untouched).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_studio_onboarding.py — fully hermetic (fresh email per module). For UI, key testIDs are: studio-onboarding-screen, onb-{contact-name,studio-name,phone,city,country}, onb-purpose-<Label> (e.g. onb-purpose-Weddings), onb-team-<Label>, onb-volume-<Label>, onb-website, onb-referral, onb-submit, onb-signout. Note: existing admin@lumiere.studio has profile_complete=false in the seed and WILL be redirected to onboarding on login — this is by design ('applies to existing accounts too'). If a future feature needs to skip onboarding for that seeded account, back-fill studio_profile in seed.
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature verified working as specified. Backend contract complete, frontend gate + form flow complete.
